info.title: AI Copilot Backend API
info.description: Backend API for AI Copilot web application with session-based chat using Google Gemini API

get.description: Check if the API is running and healthy

post.description: Creates a new chat session with a unique UUID identifier
Send a message to the AI assistant and receive a reply

get.description: Retrieve the chronological message history for a given session

session_id.title: Session Id
session_id.description: Unique session identifier for maintaining conversation context

message.title: Message
message.description: User message to send to the AI assistant
message.example: Can you help me write a Python function?

ChatRequest.title: ChatRequest
ChatRequest.description:
Request model for sending a chat message.

Attributes:
    session_id: Unique identifier for the chat session
    message: User's message content to send to the AI

ChatResponse.title: ChatResponse
ChatResponse.description:
Response model for chat messages.

Attributes:
    session_id: The session identifier for this conversation
    reply: AI-generated response to the user's message

messages.title: Messages
messages.description: Chronological list of messages in the conversation

example.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

HistoryResponse.title: HistoryResponse
HistoryResponse.description:
Response model for retrieving session message history.

Attributes:
    session_id: The session identifier
    messages: Chronological list of messages in the conversation

role.title: Role
role.description: Role of the message sender: 'user' or 'assistant'

content.title: Content
content.example: Hello, how can you help me?

Message.title: Message
Message.description:
Model for a single message in conversation history.

Attributes:
    role: The role of the message sender (user or assistant)
    content: The message content

SessionCreateResponse.title: SessionCreateResponse
SessionCreateResponse.description:
Response model for session creation.

Attributes:
    session_id: Newly created unique session identifier
